regime_read: The pack shows a clear AI/infrastructure-plus-government-contract convergence (NVDA, MSFT, PLTR, MU) with retail and political-affiliation channels layered on top, but the strongest single-channel signals are already priced — PLTR is extended at +44.6pp vs SPY. No track record is scored yet, so conviction stays modest and the regime read is provisional.
regime_read_zh: 证据包显示出明显的“AI/基础设施+政府合同”多重信号汇聚（NVDA、MSFT、PLTR、MU），并叠加了散户和政治关联渠道；但最强的单一信号股票已经透支——PLTR 相对 SPY 60 日跑赢 +44.6 个百分点。尚无已评分的业绩记录，因此置信度保持克制，市场状态判断仅为临时性的。

theses.thesis: MU shows the strongest non-extended convergence in the pack: congress_cluster (net 6, 3 members) and insider_mspr at 100.0 align with a patent_cluster (424 patents) and maxed stocktwits_bull. The name is -24.8pp vs SPY over 60d, so the bullish alt-data has not been chased. Earnings are 13 days out with a positive surprise history (18.6%), which is a two-sided event but the underlying data lean is clear. The affiliation with [actor:Ro Khanna] is qualitative and thin, so this is not a political-capture story — it is a HBM/memory-cycle plus Washington-interest overlap.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 是证据包中未透支的多重信号汇聚最强的标的：国会交易集群（净买入 6 笔、3 名议员）与内部人士指标 100.0 相互印证，并与专利集群（424 项专利）和满分的 Stocktwits 看多指标叠加。该股 60 日相对 SPY 为 -24.8 个百分点，说明看多的另类数据尚未被追逐。距离财报还有 13 天，且历史超预期为正（18.6%），属于双向事件，但底层数据偏向明确。与 [actor:Ro Khanna] 的关联为定性且薄弱，因此这不是政治信息差的故事，而是 HBM/存储周期与华盛顿利益重叠的迹象。
second_order: AMAT — memory capex and advanced packaging equipment supplier; congress_cluster and patent_cluster also present here
NVDA — HBM demand is the input constraint for AI accelerators
SMCI — AI-server buildout downstream of memory and compute; unusual_options put/call 0.29 shows bullish optionality
theses.dissent: The insider_mspr of 100.0 with a -24.8pp relative 60-day return could indicate insiders are buying against a structural decline — memory is deeply cyclical and the stock may be cheap for a reason. The [actor:Ro Khanna] affiliation is qualitative only and adds little independent signal.

falsifier.text: MU congress net buying turns negative over the next two disclosures, or the 9/30 earnings call guides HBM/memory pricing lower and the stock fails to hold its relative base.

theses.thesis: MSFT is the only mega-cap in the pack where Washington holdings, Trump flow, and real usage data align without extension: [actor:Trump] side=buy, congress_position_usd is $1.58B held, [actor:Sam Altman] PARTNERS_WITH (Microsoft-OpenAI compute reality), [actor:Bill Ackman] AFFILIATES_WITH is a disclosed position. The alt-usage channels — app_demand (4.77 rating, 20M reviews), github_momentum (192k stars), hf_model_momentum ($30.7M downloads/30d) — are measured organic traction, not sentiment. At +32.4pp vs SPY it is not extended by this desk's threshold.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT 是证据包中唯一一个华盛顿持仓、特朗普资金流和真实使用量数据同时对齐且未透支的超级大盘股：[actor:Trump] 方向为买入，国会持仓金额 15.84 亿美元，[actor:Sam Altman] 为合作伙伴（微软-OpenAI 算力现实），[actor:Bill Ackman] 的关联为已披露持仓。另类使用量渠道——app_demand（评分 4.77、2000 万条评论）、github_momentum（19.2 万星）、hf_model_momentum（30 天下载量 3070 万）——是可衡量的有机趋势，而非情绪。相对 SPY +32.4 个百分点，按本台的阈值并未透支。
second_order: NVDA — Microsoft is a primary buyer of AI accelerators; downstream compute demand is a direct read-through
PLTR — Azure government-cloud partner, but note PLTR is already extended
theses.dissent: A mega-cap at this scale rarely reprices on alt-data; the bulk of the signal may already be in a $4T+ market cap. Ackman's disclosed stake and Pelosi-adjacent holdings are public info, not edge.

falsifier.text: Azure/AI-model download momentum stalls for two consecutive months, or OpenAI diversifies compute away from Microsoft in a disclosed deal.

theses.thesis: AMAT has a quiet but real overlapping signal: congress_cluster (net 4, 4 members, $48M position), an analyst_upgrade_cluster with 0.97 bull ratio, and 280 patents. The unusual_options put_call of 1.07 is neutral-to-slightly-bearish on the surface, so the options channel does not yet confirm the equity lean. It is -36.3pp vs SPY, which makes it a value-style second-order beneficiary of the MU/NVDA memory-and-logic capex complex, not a momentum name. Watch rather than accumulate given the mixed options read and thin actor inventory.
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT 存在一个安静但真实的重叠信号：国会交易集群（净 4 笔、4 名议员、4806 万美元持仓）、分析师上调集群（看多比率 0.97）以及 280 项专利。不过 unusual_options 的看跌/看涨比率 1.07 表面中性偏空，因此期权渠道尚未确认股票层面的偏向。该股相对 SPY 为 -36.3 个百分点，使其成为 MU/NVDA 存储与逻辑芯片资本开支体系的估值型二阶受益标的，而非动量标的。鉴于期权信号混杂、关联人名单薄弱，选择观察而非积累。
second_order: MU — Applied Materials is a direct equipment supplier into memory fabs
NVDA — logic/foundry capex for AI accelerators
SMCI — AI-server assembly capacity depends on leading-edge chip supply
theses.dissent: Put/call above 1.0 suggests options traders may be hedging for downside despite the equity-side signals; semiconductor equipment is brutally cyclical and the -36pp relative underperformance could be the start of an orders-air-pocket, not a base.

falsifier.text: Options put/call moves decisively above 1.3, or WFE (wafer-fab equipment) vendor guidance from peers signals order pushouts into 2027.

theses.thesis: NVDA has the densest actor graph in the pack — [actor:Nancy Pelosi] HOLDS_STAKE, [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] HOLDS_STAKE, [actor:Michael McCaul] HOLDS_STAKE, [actor:Jensen Huang] CONTROLS — plus a full-bull analyst_upgrade_cluster (1.0), patent_cluster, and heavy retail_buzz (207 WSB mentions). But convergence_score is high while the stock is only +1.3pp vs SPY, meaning the story is widely known and the price has already absorbed it. The desk watches rather than accumulates: the edge here is what the dense political/stakeholder graph implies about continued policy support, not a fresh entry.
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA 拥有证据包中最密集的关联人图谱——[actor:Nancy Pelosi] 持有股份、[actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] 持有股份、[actor:Michael McCaul] 持有股份、[actor:Jensen Huang] 为其控制人——叠加全数看多的分析师上调集群（1.0）、专利集群和大量散户热度（207 条 WSB 讨论）。但收敛分数很高，而股价相对 SPY 仅 +1.3 个百分点，说明故事已被广泛知晓，价格已将其消化。本台选择观察而非积累：这里的信息优势在于这种密集的政治/利益相关方图谱所暗示的政策支持持续性，而非全新的入场机会。
second_order: MU — HBM is the bandwidth constraint for NVIDIA accelerators
AMAT — leading-edge logic and HBM tooling
MSFT — hyperscaler buyer of NVIDIA compute for Azure/OpenAI workloads
SMCI — AI-server assembly and liquid-cooling buildout
theses.dissent: The signal concentration is so dense and public that it is consensus. Multiple members of Congress holding the same mega-cap AI name makes it a policy-beta proxy rather than an undiscovered edge — and a crowded trade into any export-control or AI-capex slowdown.

falsifier.text: A new export-control action or a hyperscaler capex guidance cut (e.g., Azure/GCP/AWS commentary) that breaks the AI-accelerator demand trajectory.

theses.thesis: PLTR has the strongest single-name convergence in the pack — gov_contract_accel at 54.62 with $27.3M in 30d contracts, [actor:Trump] buy, [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] HOLDS_STAKE, [actor:Cathie Wood] AFFILIATES_WITH, full-bull analyst and stocktwits — but it is EXTENDED at +44.6pp vs SPY. The desk's rule is explicit: never accumulate an extended name. The read is a genuine overweight based on data, but the entry is gone for this horizon.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR 在证据包中拥有最强的单一名称信号汇聚：gov_contract_accel 达 54.62 且 30 天合同金额 2730 万美元，[actor:Trump] 方向为买入，[actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] 持有股份，[actor:Cathie Wood] 为关联方，分析师与 Stocktwits 全数看多——但该股已相对 SPY 跑赢 +44.6 个百分点，属于超涨标的。本台规则明确：绝不积累已超涨的标的。数据层面看多属实，但就本周期而言入场机会已经消失。
second_order: MSFT — Palantir is a key Azure Government/DoD partner; Microsoft captures a cleaner way to own the same federal-AI demand
NVDA — federal AI infrastructure buildout downstream
theses.dissent: The extension itself is the contrary case: +44.6pp in 60 days is a momentum blowoff, and the full-bull analyst/stocktwits read is a contrarian warning that everyone is already on the same side.

falsifier.text: PLTR's relative strength mean-reverts below +20pp vs SPY, reopening an entry at a non-extended level.
